An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull) The founder who helped over 50 startups hit $1M ARR shares his PULL framework for finding real product-market fit Lenny Rachitsky Oct 25, 2026 ∙ Paid 95 2 Share Transcript Rob Snyder is the author of The Power of Pull and writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups . He has advised more than 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR, drawing on his own experience as a founder who spent two years pushing a product the market didn’t want before accidentally stumbling onto what actually works. In this episode, we walk step by step through his framework for finding product-market fit, from coming up with an idea to closing your first handful of deals. Listen on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts We discuss: The PULL framework: Project, Unavoidable, List of options, Limitations Where the best startup ideas come from Tactics for cold outreach and running your first sales call Why Rob advises against design partners Goblin mode: what to do when nothing is working How to apply the PULL framework inside larger companies Brought to you by: WorkOS
